The promoted entry is `complete`.

Codegen levers carried from the legacy Behavior and re-measured in TU context: the clamp keeps the ROM's goto shape, and the mMoveDir toggle goes through a laundered integer address (the member spelling changes the function's size).

Deliberately left mangled: dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile and dBgActor_c::IsClsnInRange each take Fix12<int> by value, and a real method call homes the argument and size-DIFFs the caller (the wall 6az that include/dBgW_KcMbg.h and src/actors/daObjCtMecha10_c.cpp both record).
